checkpoint.identity: the same checkpoint used by structural_state_action_v0

data.test_labels: never indexed; no Test row is in the 1M Train plan or any artefact of this round

train_plan.canonical_pair: A_rank < B_rank, pair_key = A_rank*64 + B_rank; bond_type is 1 for every cell used
train_plan.rectangle: same canonical replacement A->B in two distinct exact contexts C1<C2; all four cells are single-identity clean cells; the four molecules are pairwise distinct; no requirement on E_AB or delta_g
train_plan.clean_cell: cell has exactly one distinct molecule identity; molecule has no explicitly encoded stereo marker and no duplicate identity row; no directory reasm_stereo==0 marker
train_plan.context_sampling: per pair type, exact contexts are ordered by hash64('ctx', pair_key, C_id); the first min(n,32) contexts are used and all C(.,2) context pairs among them are candidates
train_plan.rectangle_hash: SplitMix64 finaliser over (pair_key, C1, C2), the same label-free hash as SSTA v0
train_plan.selection: for each pair type keep the first <=32 valid rectangles in fixed hash order; then visit pair types in hash64('pair', pair_key) order in rounds, taking the r-th candidate of every pair type; keep only molecule-disjoint rectangles and stop at 8000, never adding an overlapping rectangle to fill the cap; no label, prediction or error enters selection
train_plan.plain: 4 x rectangle count molecules from the original 1M Train row plan, ranked by a fixed hash of the cache row; excludes every rectangle endpoint gid and endpoint molecule identity

batch.duplicate_endpoints: if a batch contains duplicate rows, the unique rows are forwarded once and predictions are gathered back to the original graph order; loss weights are unchanged
batch.batch_plan: pre-computed per-epoch permutations of rectangles and plain molecules with numpy default_rng(0), one draw per epoch in the fixed order rectangle then plain; identical for all three arms

horizon_rule: 5 epochs unless the measured preflight (one real epoch plus full official-Valid inference) projects the three-arm formal run above the 5-10 minute target; in that case the single frozen horizon becomes 3 epochs for all arms. Intermediate predictions never change the horizon.

optim.lr_schedule: per-step linear decay from lr_start at step 0 to lr_end at the last step of the frozen horizon; no warmup, no search
optim.optimizer_state: fresh AdamW state for every arm; this is not a seamless resume of the original W3 trajectory

loss.units: all losses are computed on the original W3 standardised label z = (gap_eV - mean_eV)/std_eV
loss.endpoint_error: e_i = pred_i - target_i in endpoint order [C1+A, C1+B, C2+A, C2+B]
loss.ABS: L = mean over all graphs of |e|
loss.PAIR: L_abs = mean over all graphs of |e|; L_pair = mean over rectangles of (|e2-e1| + |e4-e3|)/4; L = L_abs + L_pair
loss.RECT: L_abs = mean over all graphs of |e|; L_rect = mean over rectangles of |(e4-e3)-(e2-e1)|/4; L = L_abs + L_rect
loss.note: PAIR and RECT use exactly the same rectangles, plain molecules, batch plan and initial parameters; only the auxiliary term differs

evaluation.full_valid_mae: official PCQM4Mv2Evaluator MAE on all 73,545 official Valid rows, plus an independent NumPy cross-check
evaluation.train_subset_mae: independent whole-graph MAE on the unique molecules of this round's Train subset; labelled as a continuation subset, never as the full 1M Train metric
evaluation.replacement_delta: frozen Structural Effect Diagnosis v0 / SFEC v1 Valid pair observations (n=36,952 evaluable), canonical A->B orientation
evaluation.interaction_D: frozen SSTA v0 rectangle directory (59,214 rectangles, 1,542 pair types) and its fixed-hash subsets

subsets.all: all matched observations / all frozen SSTA rectangles
subsets.unseen_exact_context: replacement observations whose exact context hash64 is absent from the 1M Train prefix
subsets.both_contexts_unseen: SSTA rectangles whose two exact contexts are both absent from the 1M Train prefix
subsets.molecule_disjoint: the SSTA v0 molecule-disjoint rectangle subset (greedy, independently inside each pair type)
subsets.same_edit: the frozen 946 same-edit rectangles (auxiliary mechanism evaluation)
subsets.strict: the frozen 38 strict rectangles (descriptive only; below the SSTA support threshold)

evaluation.interaction_unit: pair type (observation-equal and molecule-disjoint reported as sensitivity)
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: best full official Valid MAE, including epoch 0; fixed-final-epoch results are reported separately

state.pair_selection: one real Valid replacement pair per pair type, pair types ordered by fixed hash, first <=128
state.shift: one fixed per-head constant for every molecule of a checkpoint, calibrated on the fixed state-pair sample; the same shift is used across molecules
state.phi: [1, f(h_v), h_v, h_v^2, exp(score_k-c_k), exp(score_k-c_k)*h_v for k=1..4]
state.prediction_decomposition: delta_F = delta_sum_f + delta_rho + delta_attention, converted from z to eV by the frozen label standard deviation
state.example_rule: 2 real replacement pairs (smallest and largest absolute replacement error inside the fixed 128) and 1 fixed-hash strict same-edit rectangle; reported honestly as success/failure
state.no_interpreter: no interpreter is trained and no explanation loss is added

correctness_checks: epoch 0 reproduces the historical W3 predictions and Valid MAE
three arms have bitwise identical initial parameters
three arms have identical training rows, occurrence counts and batch plan
rectangle orientation, endpoint labels and double-difference signs are correct
all training rows belong to the original 1M Train row plan
ABS / PAIR / RECT match a manual small-sample calculation
PAIR / RECT auxiliary gradients are finite and non-zero
